verdict.rationale: Automatic pull-request review is a fair question for an AI coding tool, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only local chat-driven editing, /ask questions, and scripting via --message or the Python API. A user could build a review step from those, but that is a developer building block, not a documented automatic PR review feature. One community comment only muses about adding a review agent after PRs, which is hypothetical, not affirmative support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic code review with contextual feedback on every pull request
